summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K furnishing its weekly transaction report under the third tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme, announced 22 July 2026 and running 23 July to no later than 26 October 2026. From 5-9 October 2026 the company repurchased 708,444 own shares at a weighted average of NOK 408.3895, taking cumulative tranche buy-backs to 7,697,832 shares at NOK 396.5241 for NOK 3.05bn. Equinor now holds 22,332,567 treasury shares, 0.93% of capital. Watch execution pace through the tranche deadline and any further tranche renewal.
